Use Your Home Care Experience in a Bigger Role

Homecare by Athena is seeking an experienced home\-care professional to coordinate daily office operations while continuing to provide scheduled in\-home care.

This is a full\-time role for someone who understands both sides of excellent home care: supporting clients directly and making sure caregivers, schedules and office operations run smoothly.

We are a locally owned nonmedical home\-care company serving Roseville, Rocklin, Granite Bay, Lincoln, Loomis and nearby communities. We support adults with a wide range of care needs, including memory loss, disability, recovery from illness or surgery, and assistance with daily activities.

As an early member of our team, you will help shape our systems, caregiver culture and client experience as the company grows.

What You Will Do

* Coordinate caregiver schedules and client assignments
* Match caregivers with clients based on needs, experience, location and availability
* Communicate with caregivers, clients and family members
* Help resolve call\-outs and scheduling changes

* Track HCA registrations, certifications, training and required documentation

* Comfort using computers, scheduling systems and mobile applications
* Reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license and current auto insurance
* Current CPR and First Aid certification, or the ability to obtain them promptly
* Ability to complete all required background and employment clearances

Home\-care scheduling or management software experience is strongly preferred.

* Competitive pay of $23\.00–$28\.00 per hour
* A full\-time role with varied, meaningful responsibilities
* Paid orientation and training
* Mileage reimbursement for approved work\-related driving
* Referral\-bonus opportunities
* Direct access to local company leadership

* Opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly describe your caregiving experience, home\-care office or coordination experience, software experience, current HCA status and interest in this combined role.

We are seeking a dependable home\-care professional who understands clients, caregivers and the operational work required to support both successfully.

Homecare by Athena is an equal\-opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
**Mission Statement**


Through the use of social and restorative justice principles, Five Keys provides traditionally underserved communities the opportunity to improve their lives through a focus on the Five Keys: EDUCATION, EMPLOYMENT, RECOVERY, FAMILY, COMMUNITY.




**Five Keys Overview**


Five Keys is a nonprofit organization that operates an extensive network of programs across California. With a presence in 14 counties and over 120 locations, Five Keys focuses on various initiatives aimed at empowering individuals and families to overcome poverty and inequity. The organization's programs encompass a wide range of services, including public charter schools, restorative justice programs in jails and prisons, shelters, permanent supportive housing, and the development of new housing and support programs. At Five Keys, the overarching objective is to uplift individuals and families by providing them with essential resources. This includes education, housing, employment, and the necessary tools to sustain their progress. By offering these fundamental elements, the organization aims to create positive and lasting change in communities, making them better places for everyone.




**Housing Services Overview \- A Unique Opportunity**

Five Keys Housing Services aims to provide a warm, thriving community of support and services tailored to the unique needs of unhoused individuals at our various sites. Our goals are to provide outstanding customer service to our guests; excellent training and support to our staff; and ensure a safe, welcoming and clean environment for each of our guests to call home as long as they are with us. Our housing sites are unique in their approach to our clients, emphasizing low barriers to entry and a flexible approach to rules and requirements. Our goal is to support people who are often unsuccessful in traditional shelter or housing settings.


**Our Core Competencies**


A well qualified candidate has the capacity to communicate effectively, collaborate with others while building positive relationships, demonstrates strong problem solving skills, has a dynamic learning mindset, and remains committed to a high level of cultural and social awareness. A successful candidate will work well under pressure, observe appropriate boundaries and operate with a high degree of emotional intelligence.




**What it’s really like to join our agency…**


At Five Keys, culture matters. Culture is at the very core of everything we do and impact on a daily basis. We’ve made a commitment to building an inclusive culture that seeks collaboration over hierarchy to create empowered work teams. We serve vulnerable populations daily and we strive to approach everyone with compassion, patience and a trauma informed approach. We choose to push past discomfort to have difficult conversations to impact the greater good. This allows us the opportunity to collaboratively create an inclusive culture and transform the world around us.




**BENEFITS**


We offer affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with generous paid time off. Employees may participate in pre\-tax flexible spending accounts and a 403(b) retirement plan. We provide annual reimbursements of up to $100 for gym memberships, smoking cessation programs, and weight loss programs, as well as up to $50 per year for athletic event participation and massages. Additional company\-paid benefits include access to a wellness app, wellness coaches, and an Employee Assistance Program for employees and their dependents

**JOB SUMMARY**


The Care Coordinator position reports to their assigned Director of Care Coordination and is accountable for providing comprehensive case management and supportive services to guests in Five Keys interim housing. Care Coordinators conduct participant assessments, develop individualized service plans, and connect guests to appropriate internal and external resources to support stability, well\-being, and progression toward permanent housing.


The primary objective of the Care Coordinator is to empower guests to overcome barriers, build self\-sufficiency, and achieve positive housing outcomes. In addition, Care Coordinators collaborate closely with partner agencies to ensure smooth transitions as guests exit interim housing into permanent housing, treatment programs, or other appropriate placements, including providing follow\-up aftercare support when needed.  

We are looking for someone who insists on maintaining a positive attitude and enjoys supporting a diverse group of people. If this is the right job for you, you are a self\-starter who is able to work independently with minimal supervision, effectively manage competing responsibilities, and deliver high\-quality, compassionate services in a fast\-paced environment.




**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct thorough assessments of guest's needs, strengths, and challenges
* Develop individualized care plans in partnership with guests, community partners, and service providers to address both immediate and long\-term needs, including housing, employment, healthcare, and social supports
* Connect guests with appropriate resources and services, including housing programs, mental health services, substance use treatment, job training, and legal assistance
* Advocate for guests' rights and their needs within the shelter and the broader community by coordinating with social service agencies, government entities, and community organizations
* Provide immediate support and intervention during crisis situations, including mental health crises, substance abuse relapses, domestic violence incidents, or medical emergencies
* On an ongoing basis, monitor guests' progress, update care plans as needed, document interactions

**East Oakland Community Project**

**JOB DESCRIPTION: Shelter Service Linkage Case Manager**

**Title:** Shelter Service Linkage (formerly Singles Case Manager)  

**Department:** Crossroads Case Management Services  

**Reports to:** Case Management Services Manager  

**Caseload Ratio:** 30 shelter participants


**Salary: $55,000\.00 Annual**

**Summary**


The Shelter Service Linkage Case Manager functions as an integral member of the Crossroads Shelter team. This role bridges traditional case management with specialized service linkage, taking a holistic, strengths\-based approach to helping single adults stabilize, access vital community resources, and successfully exit to permanent housing. Operating under a strict Harm Reduction and Trauma\-Informed care framework, this position is responsible for conducting basic service plans, connecting clients to dedicated housing navigators, maintaining external service partnerships, and coordinating comprehensive community referrals.


**Core Responsibilities \& Service Delivery**

**1\. Service Plan Development \& Client Evaluation**

* **Holistic Assessment:** Conduct or update basic service plans that evaluate participant needs, mapping out historical and current external services received. Focus on building participant strengths and promoting personal fulfillment.
* **Intake Coordination:** Ensure specific health insurance (Medi\-Cal/Medicare), primary doctor, and pharmacy information is documented at intake to facilitate healthcare alignment.
* **Privacy Mandate:** Strictly adhere to county standards limiting medical and behavioral health queries to only those required by HMIS to protect client privacy.
* **Goal Setting \& Check\-ins:** Meet regularly with participants—including mandatory weekly check\-ins—to monitor progress, troubleshoot barriers, and adjust goals.

**2\. Housing Service Linkage \& Collaboration**

* **Housing Navigation Alignment:** Formally connect all eligible shelter participants to *Housing Community Supports (HCS) Housing Navigation* services under the direction of Alameda County Health Housing and Homelessness Services (H\&H).
* **Provider Collaboration:** Coordinate actively with assigned external housing navigators. Provide space on\-site for client\-navigator meetings and participate in bi\-monthly case conferencing.
* **Housing Search \& Mediation:** Assist in coordinating local searches for affordable units and support positive relationships with property managers and landlords to facilitate placement.

**3\. Information, Referral, \& Landscape Scans**

* **Resource Scan:** Conduct proactive regional and online scans of accessible community programs supporting stability, health, education, and quality of life.
* **Self\-Service Resource Library:** Compile and continually maintain an updated list of these community resources, ensuring it is accessible to participants on\-site without required staff intervention.
* **Warm Handoffs:** Actively build operational relationships with local providers. Facilitate smooth entry into external systems (medical, mental health, substance use treatment, public benefits) via personal introductions and appointment scheduling.
* **Voluntary Participation Principle:** Respect the self\-determination of participants by ensuring they are explicitly informed that all non\-housing navigation services are completely voluntary.

**4\. Transportation Coordination**

* **Access Support:** Arrange or directly provide agency\-supported transportation (via agency vehicle, public transit passes, or rideshare) for essential client appointments. This includes medical visits, job interviews, school obligations (up to one week), and housing viewings.

**5\. Administration \& Data Tracking**

* **Data System Fidelity:** Document all client service plans, progressive interactions, and referrals accurately in the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS).
* **Compliance Reporting:** Gather statistical data and prepare mandatory monthly reporting strings, including CHASS logs, referral files, voucher per diems, and tracking metrics.
* **Progressive Behavior Management:** Participate in the progressive warning and corrective action system before enforcing an involuntary discharge, ensuring supervisor approval and client grievance form delivery are properly executed.

**Qualifications \& Competencies**

* **Experience:** 3 to 5 years of dedicated case management experience within the housing crisis or human services sectors.
* **Framework Mastery:** Demonstrated exposure to and understanding of **Housing First**, **Harm Reduction**, and **Trauma\-Informed Care** principles as well as **Motivational Interviewing**.
* **Core Skills:** High\-level competency in conflict resolution, verbal de\-escalation, and motivational interviewing.
* **Systems Literacy:** Experience navigating diverse populations in urban environments; knowledge of the dynamics of homelessness, substance use disorders, and mental health conditions.
* **Technical Proficiencies:** Strong working proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and electronic databases/HMIS workflows, able to navigate web, able to retrieve resources via web, compose/uses email daily

RISE DBT IOP is a comprehensive Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) for suicidal and self\-harming adolescents in grades 8–12 within CHC’s Clinical Services Division. Developed collaboratively by Children’s Health Council (CHC) and Stanford Children’s Health, RISE DBT IOP supports adolescents and families on the mid\-peninsula and is the only comprehensive DBT IOP in Northern California focused on adolescents with acute suicidal and self\-injurious behaviors. We are looking for a Clinical Case Manager to join our team. This position would be a 0\.8 Full Time Equivalent position (about 32 hours a week).



Job Summary



As the RISE IOP/DBT Clinical Case Manager, you serve as a primary point of contact for families seeking DBT services at CHC and help guide them through the RISE Intensive Outpatient Program. Working closely with the RISE Clinical Team, Care Coordinators, and the RISE Clinical Program Manager, you support families from their first inquiry through intake, program participation, and discharge planning.



Family and Referral Support



You respond to inquiries about CHC’s DBT programming, including the RISE Intensive Outpatient Program, from parents, medical and mental health professionals, school staff, and providers from other levels of care. Using strong clinical judgment, empathy, and a deep understanding of RISE services and clinicians, you help families identify services that are appropriate for their needs.



Screening, Intake, and Care Coordination



You are fully integrated into the RISE IOP team and work closely with clinical staff to understand program details, coordinate client needs, and determine appropriate levels of care. You manage and participate in the screening and intake process, collaborating with families, the clinical team, and current treatment providers to support a seamless transition into RISE IOP.



You also support outpatient DBT programming within Clinical Services by managing client screenings, coordinating intake with DBT providers, and helping determine clinical fit and level of care. As families move through treatment and discharge, you partner with RISE clinicians to connect them with appropriate ongoing care within CHC or the community.



Program Operations



You balance the needs of families, referral sources, and other consumers with the operational needs of RISE. * Respond to all phone and email inquiries about CHC DBT programming, including RISE IOP, live when possible or by the end of the next business day.

HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union\-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** M\-F, 8am\-4:30pm
  
  

JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re\-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  

CalAIM, a Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) initiative, aims to improve Medi\-Cal recipients' quality of life and health outcomes through system reforms. It introduces Enhanced Care Management (ECM), a statewide Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plan (MCP), that offers person\-centered, community\-based highest care management tier within the Medi\-Cal MCP Population Health Management continuum. Participating members are assigned a Care Manager who will meet them wherever they are: on the street, in a shelter, in their provider’s office, or at home to coordinate their health\-related care and services, ensuring holistic approach to their well\-being. In addition, ECM offers community\-based services to address health\-related social needs to help members live healthier lives and avoid more costly levels of care. Some examples include support to secure and maintain housing, access to medically tailored meals for short\-term recovery, and various other community\-based services.
  
  

The Care Manager I facilitates care by connecting clients with suitable services to meet their needs, including physical and mental health, substance use issues, employment (both residential and outpatient), legal concerns, housing, community resources, and aftercare. This in\-person and field\-based role involves working directly with members in diverse settings such as their homes, homeless encampments, service provider locations, and other areas requiring outreach, therefore, reliable transportation is required.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Enrollment and Engagement
  
* Identify eligible individuals from various locations for enrollment into ECM.
* Use multiple strategies for engagement (in\-person meetings, mail, email, texts, telephone, community outreach).


Client Care Activities
  
* Organize client care activities according to Managed Care Plan (MCP) requirements.
* Share information with the client’s multi\-disciplinary care team.
* Implement activities identified in the MCP.
* Provide support to engage clients in their treatment including medication review, appointment scheduling, transportation coordination, and addressing barriers to engagement.
* Assist with intake by completing required assessments.
* Connect clients to benefits, healthcare services, employment, housing, and community resources.
* Monitor client’s progress toward achieving treatment plan goals and provide treatment plan input.


Care Coordination
  
* Maintain regular contact with all providers involved in the client’s care team.
* Ensure continuous and integrated care among all service providers.
* Refer and follow up with primary care, mental health, substance use disorder treatment, and necessary community\-based services.
* Collaborate with clients and their families for community reintegration.
* Collaborate with outside agencies to obtain needed community resources (housing, sober livings, substance abuse recovery agencies, medical facilities, employment/education agencies, DPSS, DMV or other needed resources).
* Communicate collaboratively with all members of the behavioral health team.


Field\-Based Responsibilities
  
* Meet ECM clients at their physical locations and cater to their individual needs.
* Conduct care management activities in locations most attainable and desirable for clients.
* Have access to office space for care management activities and attend required training and meetings as needed.
* Submit mileage for field\-based care management activities for reimbursement.


Administrative Duties
  
* Write and complete all progress notes within 24 hours of service delivery.
* Write client progress letters and court reports.
* Actively participate in assigned Group Supervision, agency, and team meetings.
* Participate in training opportunities and complete assigned training in a timely manner.


And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  

QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education, Certification, or Licensure
  
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Valid First Aid and CPR certification or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire.
* Valid California driver’s license and access to registered and insured transportation.


Experience
  
* Care management experience.
* Experience working with clients experiencing acute withdrawal from substances.
* Experience working with the criminal justice population preferred.
* Experience working with Medi\-Cal, Medi\-Care, and private medical insurance plans preferred.
* Experience providing trauma\-informed services preferred.
* We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
* Must complete a background check and livescan.
* Must complete background check and live scan.
* We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

**The role**

You are the voice our members hear. From the moment someone signs up, you're the person welcoming them, gathering their files, and telling them when everything is ready. For most of our members, you are the company — the only human they interact with. That makes this job a very important one.

We're an early\-stage startup in the pet space. We help pet owners understand what their pet's body is telling them long before anything shows on the outside. Members sign up, build a profile for their pet, and we bring together everything we can learn about that pet's health.

**The role**

You are the voice our members hear. From the moment someone signs up, you're the person welcoming them, gathering their files, and telling them when everything is ready. For most of our members, you are the company — the only human they interact with. That makes this job a very important one.

**What you'll do**

*Welcome every new member*

Every member who joins hears from you first. You'll send the welcome message, point them to their next step, and follow up with anyone who doesn't finish setting up. We have templates — your job is to make sure they never read like templates.

*Document management*

You request, track, and organize Member files, obtaining them by phone, by email, and through online forms. These requests are rarely a priority for the people on the other end, so it takes persistence — and moving quickly is critical.

*Sync files to the system*

Every record that comes in gets uploaded and attached to account. This has to be right every time.

*Close the loop* 

Once the files are synced, you text the member to let them know their profile is now complete and what they can do with it. This is the moment the product gets meaningfully better for them, and you're the one who gets to deliver that message!

*And, as you go: make it better*

You'll run this at volume, so you'll be the first to see where it breaks. We want you to tell us — and to help fix it.

**What we're looking for**

* Relentless follow\-up. A person who calls a fourth time and still has the other end on your side.
* Real attention to detail. You'll be handling a high volume of interactions.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Most of this job is words: texts, emails, forms, with some calls. You need to be clear, warm, and precise.
* Volume tolerance. Hundreds of messages and a chase list of hundreds of open requests. You need a system, and you need to not lose things.

**Nice to have**

* Prior CRM or customer support experience
* Early\-stage startup experience: you know what it's like when the process is still being written
* Experience with pets
